PACTA_Vietnam_Bank_Report.html.title: PACTA Vietnam Bank Report
PACTA_Vietnam_Bank_Report.html.summary: Vietnam-specific PACTA alignment narrative for the synthetic Mekong Commercial Bank portfolio.

2026-04-16-final-vietnam-bank-trisk-demo.title: Final Vietnam Bank TRISK Demo
2026-04-16-final-vietnam-bank-trisk-demo.summary: Combined client-facing synthesis of the Vietnam PACTA baseline and TRISK power pilot.

2026-04-16-trisk-power-pilot.html.title: TRISK Power Pilot
2026-04-16-trisk-power-pilot.html.summary: Power-sector stress-test report with borrower-level NPV and PD changes plus sensitivity findings.

BIDV_Framework_Recommendation_Report.htm.title: BIDV Framework Recommendation Report
BIDV_Framework_Recommendation_Report.htm.summary: Comparison of climate risk/alignment frameworks (PACTA, PCAF, TRISK, TCFD/ISSB, GFANZ/NZBA, SBTi FI, NGFS) mapped to Decision 263 and recommended for a Vietnamese bank's adoption roadmap.

SLL_Readiness_Shortlist.html.title: SLL Readiness Shortlist
SLL_Readiness_Shortlist.html.summary: Ranks and bands a qualified pool of borrowers for sustainability-linked-loan structuring on transition materiality, ticket size, data availability, and (when configured) relationship signals -- a different question from the transition-risk severity ranking. Does not select the final shortlist; that is an analyst decision recorded in sll_readiness.csv.

Sector_Target_Registry.html.title: Sector Target Registry
Sector_Target_Registry.html.summary: One row per sector per horizon (2030 proposed, 2035/2050 not_set) carrying baseline and SDA-convergence or market-share targets, with an explicit note that PACTA gaps are benchmark-measured while targets are convergence-computed.

Financed_Emissions.html.title: Financed Emissions (Scope 1+2)
Financed_Emissions.html.summary: PCAF-style Scope 1+2 financed-emissions inventory with a data-quality composition (scores 1-5) for every published total, plus carbon-cost exposure valued against the NGFS carbon-price pathway. Automotive and coal mining are excluded (Scope 3-dominant); see the report for the exclusion statement.

Run_History_Diff.html.title: Run History Diff
Run_History_Diff.html.summary: Compares the two most recent recorded pipeline runs, showing which sectors and borrowers' composite scores moved and by how much -- see history/<bank_slug>/ for the full append-only run archive.

Scenario_Vintage_Comparison.html.title: Scenario Vintage Comparison
Scenario_Vintage_Comparison.html.summary: Shows what changed in the portfolio's alignment gap when the benchmark scenario vintage changed (Decision 500/QD-TTg PDP8 2023 vs the Decision 768/QD-TTg Adjusted PDP8 2025), holding the loanbook fixed -- see data/scenarios/pdp8-2025-adjusted/SOURCE.md for provenance and caveats.

PACTA_Alignment_Report.html.title: PACTA Alignment Report
PACTA_Alignment_Report.html.summary: r2dii-package demonstration report built on the bundled European demo loanbook, not the Vietnam MCB portfolio. Retired from the public snapshot (Wave 3 PHASE-02, N-008 / DEC-006): a European demo portfolio inside a Vietnam-facing showcase is a mislabeling risk. Kept in the catalog as a methodology reference only, not eligible for publication.

PACTA_Comparison_Report.html.title: PACTA Comparison Report
PACTA_Comparison_Report.html.summary: r2dii-package demonstration report built on the bundled European demo loanbook, not the Vietnam MCB portfolio. Retired from the public snapshot for the same reason as PACTA_Alignment_Report.html.
